title: Election roadmap becomes a central political question
detail: Public attention intensifies around election scheduling, legal framework, and administrative preparedness for the 13th parliamentary vote.

title: Debate centers on participation and credibility
detail: Political actors and civil voices debate whether participation conditions, oversight, and campaign space are sufficient for broad legitimacy.

title: Election discourse linked to longer democratic trajectory
detail: The 2026 cycle is widely interpreted in relation to unresolved debates from earlier election periods, especially around trust, rules, and transfer of power.
